scientific_limitations: The result concerns uniform unrooted labelled Cayley trees under fixed numeric vertex order, not increasing-tree or minimum spanning-tree laws.
The limiting point-process law is asymptotic; no global finite-order total-variation bound is claimed.
Prior equivalence in a broad general theorem for sparse edge sets remains a bibliographic risk.
title: Poisson extremal-edge geometry and an independent endpoint-split law for uniform Cayley trees
